Estimated end-of-life date, accurate to within three months: 05-2027
See [the support level definitions](https://docs.datadoghq.com/tracing/trace_collection/compatibility/python/#releases) for more information.

## v4.17.2

### Bug Fixes

- Code Security (IAST)
  - Fixes an issue where untrusted deserialization vulnerabilities are reported with an unrecognized vulnerability type and are not displayed correctly in Datadog.
- profiling
  - Fixes an issue where the stack profiler's CPU usage grows over time, and stays high even when the application is idle, in asyncio applications that run many short-lived tasks with `asyncio.gather`. Also fixes asyncio tasks that could go missing from profiles after calling `asyncio.gather`.
  - Fixes an issue where an asyncio Task created with `asyncio.create_task` is sometimes reported without the stack of the Task that created it.
  - Fixes an issue where the experimental remote configuration feature listened to more configuration types than expected.
- tracing
  - Fixes `runtime.python.gc.pause.time` and `runtime.python.gc.pause.max` overcounting GC pause time when other threads held the GIL during a collection.
